newsitem.title: USA: GE real estate unit names Pressman president.
newsitem.headline: GE real estate unit names Pressman president.

text.p: GE Capital Services said on Tuesday it named Ron Pressman president of GE Capital Commercial Real Estate Financing and Services.
Pressman comes from General Electric Co, GE Capital Services's parent, where he worked for 16 years.
He replaces Michael Fraizer, who will now serve as a senior vice president at GE Capital. Pressman will report to Fraizer.
GE Capital Commercial Real Estate has more than 25 offices worldwide, and a portfolio of about $18 billion.
